entry.name: string.sprintf
entry.digest: Generate a string using C-style message formatting
entry.description: Uses the common C-language "printf" function to generate strings. You can combine symbols, organize lists of numbers, or format messages or menu items. For complete documentation, refer to a standard C library reference manual.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: The arguments form a message to be sent out, in a format resembling the C programming language. The arguments may be words, numbers, or changeable arguments for incoming symbols ((), floats (), and ints that are to be formatted as ASCII characters (). The number of inlets is determined by the number of changeable arguments, with each inlet corresponding to a changeable argument, in order.
